**Runs MariaDB 11 · macOS and Linux** · [registry page ↗](https://doze-dev.com/registry/doze/mariadb/)

<!-- recipe:start -->

Run a MySQL-compatible database for your app, with its users and grants
declared beside it.

MariaDB is the community fork of MySQL, begun by MySQL's original authors and
licensed GPLv2. It speaks the MySQL protocol, so `mysql://` drivers, the
`mysql` and `mariadb` clients, and GUIs connect unchanged.

## A database

```hcl
module mariadb "db" {
  version = "11.4"
}
```

The database is named after the block and created on the first start.

```sh
doze url db
# mysql://root@db.shop.doze:3306/db
```

Hand it to an app by reference: `DATABASE_URL = module.db.url`.

## Users and grants

```hcl
module mariadb "app" {
  version       = "11.4"
  character_set = "utf8mb4"

  user "app" {
    password = "secret"
    host     = "%"
  }

  grant {
    user       = "app"
    privileges = ["ALL PRIVILEGES"]
    database   = "app"
  }
}
```

An app that logs in as `app` builds its URL around the address:

```hcl
app "api" {
  run  = "php artisan serve --port=$PORT"
  port = 8000
  env  = { DATABASE_URL = "mysql://app:secret@${module.app.address}/app" }
}
```

## Server settings

`settings` adds lines to the `[mysqld]` section of the server's config:

```hcl
module mariadb "db" {
  version  = "11.4"
  settings = { max_connections = "50" }
}
```

<!-- recipe:end -->

## Reference

A socket-only MariaDB backend behind the doze proxy, with declarative databases, users, and grants. The instance database is created automatically; connect via DATABASE_URL.

### Every field at once

<!-- ground:skip -->
```hcl
module mariadb "app" {
  version       = "11.4"
  character_set = "utf8mb4"

  user "app" {
    password = "secret"
    host     = "%"
  }
  grant {
    user       = "app"
    privileges = ["ALL PRIVILEGES"]
    database   = "app"
  }
}
```

### Versions you can declare

The `version =` you write is the engine's own version. Declare a series and
doze pins its newest published build, or declare an exact build. Either way it
is fetched, verified and pinned in `doze.lock`, so it never moves on its own.

| `version =` | pins (today) | exact builds |
|---|---|---|
| `11.4` | `11.4.13` | 12 |
| `11.8` | `11.8.9` | 8 |

<details>
<summary>Every exact build, per series</summary>

**11.4**: `11.4.13` · `11.4.12` · `11.4.11` · `11.4.10` · `11.4.9` · `11.4.8` · `11.4.7` · `11.4.6` · `11.4.5` · `11.4.4` · `11.4.3` · `11.4.2`

**11.8**: `11.8.9` · `11.8.8` · `11.8.7` · `11.8.6` · `11.8.5` · `11.8.4` · `11.8.3` · `11.8.2`

</details>

_The binaries mirror also publishes `12.0` · `12.1` · `12.2` · `12.3`: declarable once the module supports those series._


### Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | string | — | MariaDB server version (e.g. 11.4) **Required.** |
| `character_set` | string | — | default charset for the instance database (e.g. utf8mb4) |
| `collation` | string | — | default collation for the instance database |
| `settings` | map(string) | — | extra [mysqld] my.cnf entries |

Every module block also takes doze's own fields: `port`, `listen`, `sleep`,
`after`, `enabled`, `routes`, `count` and `for_each`
([doze.hcl reference](/reference/doze-hcl/)).

### Nested blocks

**`user "<name>" { … }`** — a MariaDB account (repeatable; label = name; host, password)

_The module does not list this block's fields yet._

**`grant { … }`** — a privilege grant (user, privileges, database, table)

_The module does not list this block's fields yet._

### Module releases

The releases of the module that provide this engine. doze picks the newest
one that fits your doze and your `version =`, and pins it in `doze.lock`;
you never write these. Older releases stay available for pinned lockfiles.

| Release | Engine versions | Platforms | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0.2.1` | 11 | 3 | **stable** |
